newsitem.title: FRANCE: French housing aid upgraded by 2.5 bln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: French housing aid upgraded by 2.5 bln Ffr.

text.p: French transport and housing minister Jean-claude Gayssot told a social housing congress on Friday the state housing aid scheme would be upgraded from July by 2.5 billion francs.

In Paris the prime minister's office said half of the money would come directly from the state and the other half from the family benefits fund, the Caisse d'allocations familiales, which is itself funded by the social security system.

The announcement by Gayssot comes a day after Prime Minister Lionel Jospin said in his maiden parliamentary speech that housing aid would be improved. He had not put a figure on the plan in his Thursday address.
About 2.1 million people rely on the housing aid, which in 1995 amounted to 35 billion francs for the year.
